title: Nested mining universe feasibility audit
classification: pre-registered feasibility audit; no alpha search and no return backtest
question: Can the existing nested mining API validate factor candidates on a historically valid, date-varying HS300 universe using the system's actual execution and cost rules?

hypotheses.H1: The mining factor panel receives all enriched stock symbols unless a static symbols list is provided.
hypotheses.H2: The mining request has no date-varying membership input and does not apply the system HS300 mask.
hypotheses.H3: The local HS300 membership store contains only the current official snapshot, so substituting current members for historical membership would introduce survivor bias.

method: Read the mining API/runtime, HS300 membership service, standard strategy backtest membership mask, and focused tests.
Capture source hashes and inventory every local enriched daily partition without reading return metrics.
Read the live official-membership endpoint, mining availability endpoint, and 3018 candidate panel; preserve complete response evidence.
Check whether a historical, date-keyed HS300 membership archive exists under data/hs300.

decision_rule.eligible_for_alpha_search: Only if the mining factor-training panel and candidate evaluator both apply date-keyed historical HS300 membership, and the membership input is available and hash-frozen.
decision_rule.no_go: If either search or evaluation uses all symbols, a current static symbol list, or current members backfilled over history, do not run the alpha search or describe its output as HS300 alpha.

costs_to_verify.note: These are the mining API defaults; the audit verifies plumbing and records them but does not execute a candidate backtest.

prohibited_in_this_round: No alpha search, mining job, factor return calculation, strategy backtest, or candidate promotion/publication.
No provider call, data sync, enriched/factor rebuild, cache mutation, or strategy/data write.
No use of current HS300 members as a historical universe.

panel_registration.candidate_name: R303 嵌套挖掘股票池能力审计（无收益回测）

success_criteria: Complete frozen input inventory and source-code hashes are saved with SHA-256 sidecars.
The live panel registration is attempted at most once and its GET readback is retained.
The conclusion clearly separates a research-scope blocker from alpha performance and from candidate promotion gates.
